tor.text: Teroh vows to be the holy wind that avenges the Cabal's victims.
The Patriarch arranges Skellum's death in a pit fight against an Order squad led by Teroh, and Skellum passes his experience to Chainer, who swears revenge.
To earn use of the Mirari, Chainer slaughters Teroh and his corps, along with wounded troops in a Samite hospital.
